audit_timing: post-result hostile-review pass plus MASTER follow-up

LEADLAG-001.notes: Frozen 5s primary lookback, explicit references, 30s grid and 300s delayed-reference control map to executed implementation. The 30s clock grid samples a narrow slice of short impulses, so this is a weak same-venue screen rather than decisive event-time lead/lag evidence.

RV-001.notes: Primary 120s-freshness naive equal-weight logit-level-gap residual maps to the frozen specification. The broader calibrated structural/fair-value hypothesis was not tested. Sensitivity code changes target and reference freshness together; see DEVIATION-002.

MICROSTRUCTURE-001.notes: Genuine depth-snapshot times, own-move/spread/depth/age baseline, imbalance/microprice challenger and 300s delayed-feature control map to the frozen specification. microprice_displacement_over_spread equals imbalance/2 under the implemented formula, so the two challenger columns contain one degree of information.

PARTICIPANT-001.notes: Executed baseline and placebo differ from the frozen protocol; see DEVIATION-001. Post-hoc diagnostics are additionally contaminated by known Polymarket protocol exchange identities. Nominal statistics are audit/exploratory evidence only.

LOWRANK-001.notes: Corrected run uses the frozen coverage ordering and exactly the first three leave-target-out references under AMENDMENT-001. That is a documented label-free design choice, not the unique meaning of at least three. Usable evidence is from one regime/event family and its equal-event interval is degenerate for cross-event inference.

global_inference: No family is promoted. The original 25-test BH table is retained for audit and is not post-hoc recomputed after invalidating the participant lane. Primary p-values are block-level evidence conditional on observed regime windows; the equal-event bootstrap resamples regime windows rather than independent election families.
holdout_interpretation: The frozen 15 daily holdout folds are predominantly post-election/count/settlement periods; only one holdout day starts on an election day. EXP003 is not election-night validation.
review_rule: Any future corrected participant test must be a new preregistered experiment because the current outcome has been inspected. Future confirmation should use event-family-level holdouts/inference, substantive ablations, feed-health-aware quote validity and dependence-aware model comparison.
